name: maybe_Field_Gimmick3107_UpdateAction
summary: Vtable-slot-4 update of a small field gimmick: runs the base scene-object update and, while its flag is set and slot 0 is empty, replays an action name on the animator.
evidence: Callees Field_SceneObject_Show, Data_IsSlotEmpty, Game_GetWork, Anim_PlayByIdForActor; two literal action names; no callers and the class identity rests only on vtable neighbours.

name: maybe_Battle_ApplyUnitHpChange
signature: u32 maybe_Battle_ApplyUnitHpChange(BattleUi* self, u32 unit, u32 value)
summary: Validates the acting unit's effect state and HP, queues action 0x553/0x554 and records it, or subtracts the action power from the unit and returns 1.
evidence: Callees Battle_QueueActionEx, Battle_ActionRecord_GetPower, action-row lookup; direction (damage vs heal) and the 0x553/0x554 meanings remain open, single caller.

name: maybe_Battle_Ui_ShowItemDropPopup
signature: void maybe_Battle_Ui_ShowItemDropPopup(BattleUi* self, u32 recordId, u32 owner)
summary: When self+0x128E is set, pushes the action row's +0x154 message id for the owner, or +0x152 when self+0x128F is set.
evidence: Record lookup and two message fields readable, but no caller or literal proves these are item drops rather than two variants of any action message.

name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_ReleaseRecords
summary: Releases an overlay's records: clears the entries at +0x2C, sets the scene node's +0x7D flag, returns 57 0x30-byte records through Gfx_Trail_PushSample and finishes with 0x00239A1C.
evidence: No caller; only certain effects are the entry clear, scene-node flag and 57-record return loop, so the class is not proven.

name: maybe_Ui_UmaWindow_DtorDelete
summary: Deleting destructor: installs the class vtable, releases the entry objects at +0x2C, zeroes the count, runs the widget base destructor and frees the block.
evidence: Body ends in the widget base destructor and free helper, so the deleting-destructor role is certain; the class rests only on neighbouring horse-race code.

name: maybe_Ui_CursorWindowPair_Ctor
summary: Constructor of the two-slot cursor host window: Ui_Object_CtorBase, installs vtable 0x77A32C, then default-constructs two 0x50-byte Ui_CursorWindow slots with 0x4DC528.
evidence: 0x4DC528 installs the Ui_CursorWindow vtable, so the two 0x50-byte members are cursor windows and this outer object only hosts them; host class name unknown.

name: maybe_Ui_Panel_AttachNamedSpriteA
signature: void maybe_Ui_Panel_AttachNamedSpriteA(UiPanel* self, SpriteActor* panel, int record, u32 flags)
summary: Attaches a named sprite to a panel: clamps the record type byte +9, sets the sprite up with Field_SpriteActor_SetupSpriteA, builds the 0x16-byte pane name and creates the frame colour animator.
evidence: Named callees Field_SpriteActor_SetupSpriteA, Gfx_CreateSpriteMesh, Gfx_CreateFColAnimator confirm 'attach sprite A', but no callers and the owner class is unproven.

name: maybe_Ui_Panel_AttachNamedSpriteB
signature: void maybe_Ui_Panel_AttachNamedSpriteB(UiPanel* self, SpriteActor* panel, int record, u32 flags)
summary: Second named-sprite attach: identical to 0x004DD4A8 but uses Field_SpriteActor_SetupSpriteB before building the 0x16-byte pane name and the colour animator.
evidence: Same body as 0x004DD4A8 with Field_SpriteActor_SetupSpriteB; owner identity and absence of callers keep the maybe_.

name: maybe_Model_Actor_UpdateIdleCommand
summary: Queries the actor state (virtual +0xE8 with 0xDA), then resolves the actor via Menu_FindActorByHandle and sends a pose group from Battle_SelectPoseGroup through 0x005E7848; the 'idle' reading and the 0x2D timer remain unproven.
evidence: Named callees Menu_FindActorByHandle/Battle_SelectPoseGroup confirm a command is sent, but nothing names the command or the 0x2D-frame timer; body has maybe_ fields and a damaged poseCommandPending branch.

name: maybe_Fs_Request_WaitForService
signature: void maybe_Fs_Request_WaitForService(FsRequest* req, int service, int method)
summary: Invokes a service-object method and, on failure, formats the result into the request; otherwise clears the request and spins waiting for the service reply.
evidence: Callers Fs_Request_Build/Svc_AcClient_Cmd0004 and callees Svc_Object_InvokeAndStoreResult/Fs_FormatResultCode fit invoke-then-wait, but the wait loop decompiled to bad instruction data with 25 unreachable blocks.

name: maybe_Svc_ContentInfo_IsCacheCurrent
summary: Reads the 0xD0000 system word, fetches content info under the global monitor and compares the stored halfword at +0x2C with the low half of the system word to decide whether the cached content info is current.
evidence: Svc_FetchContentInfo and monitor lock/unlock are clear, but callers are only tentatively named icon-cache loaders and the corrupted Fs_BuildContentInfoArchivePath, so the Cecd/icon-cache subject is unproven.

name: maybe_Svc_ContentObject_QuerySize
summary: Queries a 2-byte attribute through vtable+0x2C, creates/initialises a 0x36C0-byte content object, fetches content info and returns 0 only when the cached size covers the queried value.
evidence: Body creates/initialises a content object (Svc_ContentObject_CreateAndRegister) and fetches content info; nothing reads a raw file, so the old Cecd_QueryRawFile wording was speculative.

name: maybe_Regex_BuildSuccessorList
signature: u32 maybe_Regex_BuildSuccessorList(RegexValue* node, RegexValueList** out, RegexList* operands, RegexList* visited)
summary: Builds the value set for one regex expression node: allocates a memo entry, links it into the node, records operand/visited links and recursively copies operand values into the result list.
evidence: Named callers Regex_OpBuildOperandSets/Regex_OpBuildOperandSetsSingle show it is called per operand node and its result is a value set; memo/visited layout still inferred.

name: maybe_Sound_SubmitAdpcmFrame
signature: unsigned maybe_Sound_SubmitAdpcmFrame(unsigned char* samples, unsigned arg2, int params, int channel, int count)
summary: Packs one ADPCM frame for the DSP: splits eight sample bytes into sixteen nibbles, combines them with the channel's predictor/step values and writes the result, then waits for the DSP event.
evidence: Packing loop is readable but the body is damaged (unaff_r5, bad instruction data, bogus func_0x005d1f7a target, impossible Os_CreateThreadWithStack call), so the frame layout cannot be re-verified.

name: maybe_Gfx_ModelPart_ReleaseAll
summary: Releases every 0x3C-byte part record of a part list, freeing each part's GPU blocks through Mem_FreeGraphicsBlock while optionally keeping the caller's part, and drops the tracked resources.
evidence: Callers Gfx_ModelSlot_Replace/Fx_SpawnEmitter and named Mem_FreeGraphicsBlock/Gfx_UnregisterResources confirm the release pass, but the body still has unaff_r4 and the list owner is not fully proven.

name: maybe_Gfx_AllocGraphicsBlockByRegion
signature: int maybe_Gfx_AllocGraphicsBlockByRegion(int address, int block, int regionType, unsigned int arg4, int cmdBuf, int force)
summary: Selects a graphics memory region by kind (1 -> 0x20000 region, 2 -> 0x30000 region), asks that region's allocator for a block and, when a block came back or force is set, submits the resulting transfer through Gfx_CmdQueue_SubmitEntry or SubmitEntryDirect; returns the block pointer.
evidence: Body never releases memory and the only caller Gfx_ModelInstance_InitFromResource stores the returned pointer, so the old Free verb was wrong; region selection and submit calls are clear.

name: Gfx_CmdBuf_ValidateSlot
summary: Reads the command buffer's current slot entry (base + index*0x48) and, when the slot's end index and write index disagree, constructs the 12 x 0x70-byte array via std_ConstructArray.
evidence: All three callers are named command-buffer/overlay routines (Gfx_SubmitSortedElement, Gfx_Overlay_FlushQuads, Gfx_Overlay_SubmitQuad); callees are Gfx_Material_BindTextureSlots, Gfx_Pica_SetLightingModel, Gfx_Pica_WriteVertexAttrCommands, Gfx_GpuCmd_EnqueueMemoryWrite.

name: maybe_Battle2DUnit_BindPartyMember
signature: void maybe_Battle2DUnit_BindPartyMember(void* self, unsigned int arg2, unsigned int arg3, unsigned int dataKey)
summary: Virtual-slot initialiser that clears slot ids, resolves the action row for self->f_1230, and when valid copies ids and rebuilds the embedded FieldParty via FieldParty_InitFromParams and Battle_Actor_Init.
evidence: No callers at all; callees Game_GetDataManager, FieldParty_InitFromParams, Battle_Actor_Init and maybe_Ui_ListRow_GetRowClass (0x0063FD24 action-row resolver) support the shape but not the class.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_ReleaseRowHandle
signature: void maybe_Field_Gimmick_ReleaseRowHandle(UiObjectList* self, int row, int arg3, Heap* heap)
summary: Damaged decompilation: Ghidra stops at a bad instruction right after Os_GetGameWork, so only the caller set (Field_Gimmick row/selection routines) is usable.
evidence: Body is halt_baddata() after Os_GetGameWork; all three callers are Field_Gimmick routines, so the class is right but the per-row release semantics are unverified.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_InitHandlerList3B
summary: Child initialiser embedded by Field_Gimmick_Ctor: installs vtable 0x00783F3C on the sub-object from 0x005D7C8C, sets defaults, initialises the member pair and constructs three 0x18-byte listeners.
evidence: Only caller is the named Field_Gimmick_Ctor; body is the same std_ConstructArray(0x18, 3) shape as 0x005D5274, but the handler type and vtable 0x00783F3C are unnamed.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_InitSlotArray8
summary: Child initialiser embedded by Field_Gimmick_Ctor: installs vtables 0x00783DAC then 0x00783F8C on the sub-object from 0x005D7C8C and constructs eight 0x0C-byte slots at +0x14.
evidence: Only caller is the named Field_Gimmick_Ctor; slot type 0x005D65D4 and both vtables are unnamed, so the name describes only the layout.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_InitParam32
summary: Small child initialiser embedded by Field_Gimmick_Ctor: installs vtables 0x00783E74 then 0x007840E8, sets -0x800 at +0x10, 0xFF none bytes at +0x1C/+0x1E, zero at +0x1D and default 0x1E at +0x20.
evidence: Only caller is the named Field_Gimmick_Ctor; the 0x1E default and vtable 0x007840E8 are unidentified, so the name describes only the layout.

name: maybe_Field_Gimmick_InitParamBlockB
summary: Second small parameter-block initialiser embedded by Field_Gimmick_Ctor: installs vtables 0x00783E9C then 0x00784110, sets -0x800 at +0x10, 0xFF none bytes and default 0x1E at +0x20.
evidence: Same none/default-0x1E pattern as 0x005E1368 with a different vtable and field base; only caller is the named Field_Gimmick_Ctor, parameter meaning unknown.

name: maybe_Data_GetFirstRowB
summary: Fourteen-instruction getter with its return value dropped by Ghidra: resolves Game_GetDataManager and returns the first row of the manager's +0x884 sub-record table via 0x0063F7BC.
evidence: 0x0063F7BC is a pure getter (ldr r0,[r0,#0x884]; ldr r0,[r0,#0x58]; bx lr); byte-identical to 0x005E889C and copies at 0x005E88D4/0x005E88F0; callers Field_NpcAction_Jump / Anim_ClipSlot_InitLinearMotion just call it.

name: maybe_Game_DataManager_NotifyA
summary: Thunk that resolves the data manager and forwards an r3 argument to 0x0063F7BC; the target and argument are unknown, so the notification semantics cannot be confirmed.
evidence: Body is Game_GetDataManager then func_0063F7BC(*manager); argument arrives in unaff r3; two unrelated callers (Anim_ClipSlot_InitArcMotion, Field_NpcAction_RunTowardTargetStart).

name: maybe_Game_DataManager_NotifyB
summary: Byte-identical template copy of 0x005E88D4: resolves the data manager and forwards an r3 argument to 0x0063F7BC; purpose still unknown.
evidence: Same body as 0x005E88D4 and same two unrelated callers; 0x0063F7BC unnamed.

name: Anim_Resource_RebindCurrentFrame
summary: Builds a frame parameter block (0x0011FFD8 plus three zeroed words) and, if the owner has an animation resource at +0xB8, binds it via Anim_Resource_Bind; shared re-attach path used by six unrelated subsystems.
evidence: Callee is named Anim_Resource_Bind; six callers span Party_Status_SetMemberValue, Gfx_SpriteActor_StopAttachedEffect, Ui_OverlaySlot_UpdateStateMachine, etc.; body checks self->animResource at +0xB8.

name: maybe_Field_NpcAction_MoveTick
summary: 20-byte forwarder called from the NPC move path that makes one call to 0x0062D6D8; the callee's camera name conflicts with the NPC callers, so the semantics stay unresolved.
evidence: Single call to 0x0062D6D8 (named Camera_FindEntryCoveringPosition) with no argument evidence; callers Field_NpcUpdateMoveState and Field_NpcAction_Move.

name: maybe_Field_NpcAction_UpdatePath
summary: Forwarder that calls 0x0062D6D8 with mode 3, targetId 0xFFFF and flags 2 (no-target containment query); only caller is Field_NpcAction_UpdateMoveAndStuckCheck, but the callee name is still unreliable.
evidence: Argument tuple (actor, arg2, 3, 0xFFFF, 2) visible; callee still carries the camera name; single named caller.

name: maybe_Actor_FindByField28
summary: Linear search over the field object manager's live entry array returning the first non-null object whose record field +0x28 equals the value; used by UI overlay slot setup/placement to resolve an id.
evidence: Loop over f_e20 entries with f_e1c array, comparing result->f_28 == fieldValue; callers Ui_Overlay_ApplySlotSetup and Ui_Overlay_ResolveSlotPlacement; companion 0x0062F514 matches +0x19.

name: maybe_Ui_PokerWindow_GetRowValue
summary: Getter that resolves the poker window's data table via 0x0063DD38 and returns the u16 at +2 of the 4-byte entry selected by index, or the same field from the window's own table at +0x34.
evidence: Both branches end in return *(u16*)(entry+2); index compared against table count and used as 4-byte stride; callers Ui_PokerWindow_Confirm/HandlePayout.

name: maybe_Field_Actor_CanPlaceAtCell
summary: Returns 0 when the actor cannot stand where it is: in 2D view when the map cell under it has attribute 9, and in any view when the attached object's kind byte is 13 or 14; otherwise 1.
evidence: Only caller Actor_UpdateModelOnStateChange; reads Field2D view flag via Field2D_GetViewFlag1B, checks cell attribute 9 and object kind 13/14; callee names in 0x0062Cxxx range unreliable.

name: maybe_Ui_Overlay_GetSlotScaleY
summary: Returns a global float at 0x007A724C multiplied by a per-mode scale (7.0f for mode 0, else the +8 field of the row from 0x0063D6B8); the sibling at 0x00634D74 does the same with +4 and 1.75f.
evidence: Disassembly shows vldr 7.0f, ldrb [overlay+0x281], conditional row lookup via 0x0063D6B8, then vmul with [0x007A724C]; callers Field_Actor_UpdateWalkInput and DBc do not pin the semantics.

name: maybe_Party_LevelGapExceedsTwo
summary: Compares the party's max member level with the level field (+0xC) of the data row selected by actor->f_20->f_768 and returns whether the gap exceeds 2, after refreshing party work via 0x0066B0E4.
evidence: Body calls Party_GetMaxMemberLevel, Data_LookupSubRecord on f_768, and returns 2 < (maxLevel - row->f_C); no callers to confirm the purpose.

name: maybe_Item_IsRecipeCraftable
signature: u32 maybe_Item_IsRecipeCraftable(WorkData* self, int recipeIndex, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Checks one crafting recipe entry (material count plus relative pointer to u16 material ids) against storage via Item_GetStoragePointer, returning 0 if any material is missing; a second entry point at 0x0063EEAC is what most callers use.
evidence: Body walks recipeIndex*0x10 entries and calls Item_GetStoragePointer per material; the 155 xrefs target 0x0063EEAC, not this address, so the recipe semantics are inferred.

name: maybe_Work_HasAnyNamedRow
summary: Returns whether the 20-entry 0x8C-byte roster table at (work+0x24A98)+0x7B3C holds at least one valid record, by testing Spirit_CountRosterEntries != 0.
evidence: Only calls Game_GetWork and Spirit_CountRosterEntries and returns count != 0; no callers, so the roster interpretation rests on the callee's name.

name: maybe_Ui_BagList_SetLabel
signature: void maybe_Ui_BagList_SetLabel(UiBagList* self, int row, u32 arg3, u32 arg4)
summary: Labels one list row: below the active party-member count it takes the member's name via Party_GetMemberActorDataB, otherwise it emits fixed label id 0xD (tool bag) or 0xE (equipment bag) chosen by self+5.
evidence: Callees Party_GetActiveMemberCount/Party_GetMemberActorDataB and constants 0xD/0xE are visible, but the emission target 0x00633560 is unnamed and there are no callers.

name: maybe_Battle_Ui_TargetGroup_ScaleBounds
summary: Scales the target group's bounds by the model scale at (self+0x2C)+0x15C and a constant, then divides each bounds float pair by the scale.
evidence: Disassembly shows float multiply by [self+0x28] and [[self+0x2C]+0x15C], a call to 0x00673DC8, then vdiv over the bounds struct; all three callers are Battle_Ui_TargetGroup_* functions.

name: maybe_Field_Placement_TestAreaC
signature: void maybe_Field_Placement_TestAreaC(FieldPlacementResult* out, int* base, int* offset, int* size, u32 testDesc, int manager)
summary: Third placement-area test: rejects the rectangle if Field_HitTestActors finds an actor, walks every cell with Map_IsCellPassable, confirms the scene rectangle via Gfx_Scene_QueryRect, and writes the accepted origin plus 1/0 into out.
evidence: Callees Field_HitTestActors, Map_IsCellPassable, Gfx_Scene_QueryRect confirm the area-test shape, but the only caller 0x002D791C is unnamed and 'C' just records it is the third of three near-identical tests.

name: maybe_Field_ComputeGridMoveDelta
signature: void maybe_Field_ComputeGridMoveDelta(int* out, GridState* grid, int unusedA, int unusedB, const int* origin, int dir, int unusedC, const int* size, int unusedD, const u8* maskA, const u8* maskB, const u8* maskC)
summary: Computes a field movement delta across square grid cells, testing collision against four adjacent boundary boxes via Gfx_Scene_QueryRect and the supplied masks.
evidence: Called by 2D field area overlap testers 0x00652F48 and 0x006539A8 and calls Gfx_Scene_QueryRect and maybe_Field_QueryFourBoxes; callers remain tentative.

name: maybe_Font_Atlas_FindPageForGlyph
signature: void maybe_Font_Atlas_FindPageForGlyph(FontAtlasSet* self, u32 target, char* outPage, u8* outCell)
summary: Scans every page's eleven stored bytes and picks the page/cell whose value is nearest at or below the target, writing the pair to the out params.
evidence: Body maps a numeric value to a (page, cell) pair by nearest-value scan; callers Anim_Clip_Build and Ui_List_FindRowIdAtPoint do not fit a font atlas, so the glyph reading remains an assumption.

name: maybe_Field2D_Sprite_ChoosePathStep
signature: int maybe_Field2D_Sprite_ChoosePathStep(Field2DSprite* sprite, const short* step, int arg3)
summary: Tests target-box overlap against sprite position plus step vector and picks a random extent clamped into bounds; large parts of the body are unrecoverable.
evidence: Overlap tests and Math_RandRangeInt(0,2) visible, but halt_baddata, SBORROW4 and a bogus func_0xffda23fe damage the body; only caller is maybe_Field2D_Sprite_AdvancePathStep.

name: maybe_Field2D_Map_SetVariantCallback
signature: void maybe_Field2D_Map_SetVariantCallback(MapRoot* self, u32 arg2, u32 variant, int mode, int apply)
summary: Installs or clears the per-variant callback of a 2D map node: modes 0/1 build a callback descriptor and call Field2D_SpriteNode_SetCallback, mode 2 rebuilds the variant object, and non-apply branches release the old object at +0xA0.
evidence: Three of four branches end in confirmed Field2D_SpriteNode_SetCallback; no callers and no vtable, so the class link is by adjacency only.

name: maybe_Os_IpcSession_PollAsyncState
summary: Polls the driver session at 0x007B2D08: reads state bytes of the object at session+0xC, returns 0 or one of several Result codes depending on state and pending counter, and re-issues command 0x19 when the counter is positive.
evidence: 0x007B2D08 is the driver-session struct (handle at +0x24); both callers are worker loops; body returns 0xF9610C02/0xC8A10C01/0xC8A10C0D and calls Os_IpcSendCommand19.

name: maybe_Os_SvcCallCheckedAlt
summary: Second checked IPC-send helper: calls one of the two raw send wrappers chosen by condition flags the decompiler lost, then applies the same error policy as 0x001221C0 (ignore 0xFFFFFFF9, report other negatives via 0x0011ED40) and returns the raw result.
evidence: Two send wrappers Os_IpcSendCommand0D/0E now named, confirming the two-variant send + assert shape, but in_CY/in_ZR are decompilation artefacts so which wrapper runs is unknown; no callers.

name: maybe_Field_NpcActionDestroyThunk
summary: Two-call deleting thunk: destroys the embedded sub-object with the base destructor and frees the allocation.
evidence: Callees Ui_Object_DtorBase and operator delete are named, but vtable 0x00758538 has only generic scene/widget slots and no constructor names the class.

name: maybe_Ui_ModeListWindow_Dtor
signature: void maybe_Ui_ModeListWindow_Dtor(void* vptr, void* object, u32 value)
summary: Base-subobject deleting destructor: installs the passed vptr and the +0x50 field on the object, then runs Ui_Object_DtorBase and the shared free thunk.
evidence: Disassembly shows str r0,[r1]; str r2,[r1,#0x50]; bl Ui_Object_DtorBase; tail b to free thunk; class link only by adjacency, no vtable or data word references this address.

name: maybe_Field_ObjectCtor
summary: Constructor of a scene object with three sub-objects: base-initialises through 0x004712D0, installs vtable 0x00759F88, seeds default vectors/ids and the 0.3f field, then chains sub-constructors 0x002F2678, Ui_SlotTable_Ctor and 0x004AC9B0.
evidence: Ui_WindowState_Init + Ui_SlotTable_Ctor as callees show the object contains a UI slot table, so the Field_ObjectCtor subsystem may be wrong; vtable 0x00759F88 has no owner and there are no callers.

name: maybe_Ui_WidgetWithTenChildren_Ctor
summary: Constructs a UI widget: base-initialises via Ui_WindowState_Init, installs vtable 0x007598B0, stores descriptor+4, seeds float sentinel 0xFFFFF000 and default-constructs ten 0xC-byte children.
evidence: Vtable store 0x007598B0 and ten 0xC-byte std_ConstructArray children are clear, but no caller or string identifies the owning widget class.

name: maybe_Ui_SceneComposite_Ctor
signature: void maybe_Ui_SceneComposite_Ctor(u32 owner, u32* createParams, u8 mode)
summary: Constructs a large composite UI container: base-initialises via Ui_WindowState_Init, installs vtable 0x00764B74, creates three intrusive child-list heads and two 0x18-byte element arrays (0xB and 0x14 entries).
evidence: Vtable 0x00764B74 has no other user and the destructor's Gfx_Sprite releases are the only class evidence; the owning screen is unnamed.
